summary.en: Muslims perform Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha with their prescribed units and times.

text.id: Muslim menunaikan Subuh, Zuhur, Asar, Magrib, dan Isya dengan jumlah rakaat serta waktu yang ditetapkan.
text.en: Muslims perform Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha with their prescribed units and times.

text.id: Subuh dua rakaat, Zuhur empat, Asar empat, Magrib tiga, dan Isya empat.
text.en: Fajr has two units, Dhuhr four, Asr four, Maghrib three, and Isha four.

text.id: Persiapan mencakup bersuci, menutup aurat, menghadap kiblat, dan memastikan waktu.
text.en: Preparation includes purification, covering the awrah, facing the qiblah, and confirming the time.

text.id: Bangun kebiasaan menjaga salat tanpa menyimpan data pribadi di dataset.
text.en: Build a habit of guarding prayers without storing personal data in the dataset.
